{{Quote|Look, I'm just here for the cargo. Don't try anything and we'll be out of here in no time.|Thrung Alewune|<ref name="GG7" />}}
'''Thrung Alewune''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who worked for [[Armanda Durkin]]. He enjoyed rejecting Ho'Din stereotypes, showing no gentleness and preferring technology to nature. He disagreed with Durkin's code against killing, and suggested that she retire.<ref name="GG7" />
